concept.title: Replacing the batteries
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the procedure for replacing the batteries of an .

conbody.p: This section describes the procedure for replacing the batteries of an .
The will send an email and create a push notification in the when the battery is low. It is recommended to replace the batteries before they become fully depleted.
On the , the Parametersscreen displays the battery status. A low-battery status means that the batteries must be replaced shortly.
Prerequisite: The requires four lithium batteries with an output of 3000 mAh. We recommend Energizer L91 lithium AA batteries.
Caution: Ensure that the motor is in a safe state before proceeding with battery replacement. Follow all safety protocols.
PPE Required:Heat-resistant gloves - When installing an on a running motor, wear heat-resistant gloves to avoid burns from the hot motor frame.
conbody.note: When removing or replacing an , handle it carefully to avoid damage to the device or surrounding components.

ol.li: Go to the plant motor location where the motor and the are located.
Locate the motor whose requires battery replacement.
Remove the from the fixing clamps and carefully remove the device’s case.
Insert the new batteries and replace the case, ensuring that the foam area covers the batteries.

section.title: Result
section.note: Replacing the batteries does not require any further action or learning process.
